background: Credit Mutuel is a French mutual banking group owned by its members through regional federations, funded by retail deposits and lending to households, farmers and small businesses, with insurance and the CIC network alongside.
synthesis: S&P rates the group A+ and Moody's Aa3, both stable. Capital is a clear strength against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 20.5% and leverage of 8.0% are both in the top quarter, against medians of 16.4% and 5.5%, and both have risen since 31 Dec 2023, CET1 by 1.3 points and leverage by 0.8 points. Liquidity is mixed, with LCR of 170% above the 151% median but NSFR of 116% in the bottom quarter against 124%. The figures run to 31 Dec 2025. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. One of the better-capitalised names in Europe.
